reuse.why: Routes every inline midpoint copy (schedule template, forecast normalizeSchedule, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview transactions) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper the client already uses.

duplication.why: Removes five duplicated range-to-amount computations; the rule now exists once.

placement.why: The worst-case rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, the shared schedule-amount module used by server and client.

scope.why: Changes only the ranged-amount rule, its call sites, tests for the helper and a release note.

maintainability.why: A single small, documented helper defines the rule; future changes touch one function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site keeps its own range computation after the change.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount/getWorstCaseAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the desktop-client callers.
